rationale: Approval requires a consequence preview. The requester reports that keyboard users cannot reach it and screen-reader users receive no failure status. The replacement makes the preview reachable, ties approval to the version shown, and assigns recovery to the approver after a confirmed failure. An uncertain submission is reconciled before retry. The verification plan covers keyboard and screen-reader use, cancellation, interruption, duplicate effects, and preservation of entered work and unrelated requests. The execution events show only reads, and the fixture snapshots match. The response correctly leaves the cause of the blocked state and any prior submission outcome unresolved.
